name: 12 Man Brunch of Doom
subtitle: very well sir, human head stuffed with tacos
rules: COST – Pick a number for X. Deplete X characters you control. Pick a character. -- EFFECT – If the picked character has X+X strength or less, destroy it.
flavor:
"If even one thing is wrong, even the slightest thing, a bad phrase, spilt salt, weak posture, anything at all...the consequences can be horrific. Exploded, melted, turned inside out, consumed by fire, filled with pudding...the 12 Man Brunch has finished many a cocksure arcanist."
— Werner Geisen, Master Ritualist
notes: Catalog typo 'the the'; EXTRA COST templating for printed COST –. No artist credit printed in footer.

name: Air Travel
subtitle: to the air!
rules: COST – Pick a character. -- EFFECT – This turn, the character gains COVERT. Draw a card.
notes: No artist credit printed in footer.

name: Ambiguity Inhibitor
subtitle: limited edition artwork by Zi Jian
rules: At the start of your turn, you must put a card from your hand on the bottom of your deck if you can. If you do, draw a card.
flavor: Get a leg up on the pile. No probalo!
notes: Printed 'you must put'; catalog drops 'you must' but is still an unconditional imperative. Artist credit only in subtitle (Zi Jian), not in footer.

name: Arcana Department
subtitle: where suspicion breeds confidence
rules: When an attacking or blocking party is formed, it must have an even number of members.
flavor: "Take two lefts, an up, and a sideways...it's the third door on your right."
notes: No artist credit printed in footer.

name: Arcana Experiment
subtitle: on the cutting edge of compulsion
rules: COST – Play this only if you have at least 5 cards in your deck. Deplete up to 5 characters you control. X is the number of characters you deplete. -- EFFECT – Search your deck for 5 cards and reveal them. Your opponent picks X of those cards. Put the picked cards into your hand and the rest into your discard pile.
notes: Catalog: 'Deploy', 'An opponent chooses', 'chosen' vs printed 'Play', 'Your opponent picks', 'picked'. No artist credit printed in footer.

name: Arcanist's Almanac
subtitle: a comprehensive course in absurdity
rules: FORESIGHT -- COST – Deplete this card. -- EFFECT – Look at the top 5 cards of either deck and put them back in any order.
flavor: Smarch 5th – Strong voidal storms from the southeast. Wear a bowler hat.
notes: Card prints 'Look at the top 5 cards of either deck'; catalog has 'up to the top 5 cards of any one deck' (adds 'up to', changes deck wording). No artist credit printed in footer.

name: Ashes of Zenobia
subtitle: used to be "Pot Roast of Zenobia"
rules: UNIQUE ASHES OF ZENOBIA -- At the start of your turn, draw a card. -- NULLIFY -- COST – Pay 5. -- EFFECT – Both players must put a character they control into its owner's hand.
flavor: Until Zenobia left the damn stove on. Again.
notes: Printed 'Both players must put' vs catalog 'Each player puts'. No artist credit printed in footer.

name: Compulsive Creeper
subtitle: let me get that...please...please...
rules: While you have an even number of cards in your hand, this card gains 1 strength, 1 life, and 1 speed.
flavor: "It appears that after the victim was murdered, the suspect cleaned the room, did the dishes, and organized his books alphabetically."
notes: No artist credit printed in footer.

name: Degenerate Molestation
subtitle: giggity giggity
rules: Your opponent cannot respond to this card. -- Your opponent must discard a card. You may play a non-resource card with numeric cost X or less for free, where X is the numeric cost of the discarded card. (You still need the proper resource icons and must pay any additional costs.) -- Repeat this until your opponent has no cards in their hand.
notes: Catalog uses newer templating (EXTRA COST: cannot respond / Pick an opponent, 'deploy', 'that player'); same play in the printed 2-player form. No artist credit printed in footer.

name: Ecto-Distillation
subtitle: complex magical process
rules: COST – Name a card. -- EFFECT – Search your deck for any number of copies of the card and reveal them. Put 1 into your hand and the rest into your discard pile. Your opponent may search your deck for any number of copies of the card and put them into your discard pile.
notes: Last sentence reordered in catalog ('An opponent may search ... If they do, put them...') but plays the same. No artist credit printed in footer.

name: Ectypal Stave
subtitle: limited edition artwork by Kenfoo
rules: COUNTERFEIT -- COST – Use this only if a tactic has been played this turn. Pay 2+X, where X is the numeric cost of the last tactic played this turn. Deplete this card. -- EFFECT – Duplicate the tactic. (A duplicate retains all rules text including extra costs, which must be paid or the duplicate is invalid and has no effect.)
notes: Catalog says 'deployed' where card says 'played'; catalog omits the italic reminder text (duplicate retains extra costs). Artist credit only in subtitle (Kenfoo), not in footer.

name: Forget
subtitle: i almost never do that
rules: COST – Pick a non-resource card. -- EFFECT – Put the card into its owner's hand. Look at your opponent's hand and pick a card. Your opponent must discard that card.
notes: Printed 'your opponent' / 'pick'; catalog 'an opponent' / 'choose'. No artist credit printed in footer.

name: Gargantuan Garbler
subtitle: limited edition artwork by Steve Bentley
rules: COVERT -- If this card attacks, you may pick a character. If you do, put that character into its owner's hand.
flavor: Steve Bentley hates children.
notes: Printed 'If this card attacks'; catalog 'When this card attacks' (same trigger). Artist credit only in subtitle (Steve Bentley), not in footer.

name: Insidious Ecto-Manipulator
subtitle: twisted master of magical energy
rules: COVERT -- At the start of your turn, you may pick a non-resource card you control. If you do, put a token on that card.
notes: Catalog 'put a token on it' vs printed 'on that card'. No artist credit printed in footer.

name: Knobby Stave
subtitle: wanna touch it?
rules: This card enters play with 2 tokens on it. -- DISRUPT -- COST – Remove 2 tokens from this card. -- EFFECT – Your opponent must discard a card.
notes: Printed 'Your opponent must discard'; catalog 'An opponent discards'. No artist credit printed in footer.

name: Land Shark
subtitle: limited edition artwork by Kenfoo
rules: COVERT -- This card gains 1 strength and 1 life for each face-down resource your opponent controls.
flavor: Kenfoo likes drawing the hairy man-butts. Just be glad he didn't use his design for the front. There are some things you can't un-see.
notes: Printed 'your opponent controls'; catalog 'each opponent controls'. Artist credit only in subtitle (Kenfoo), not in footer.

name: Lugubrian Octopod
subtitle: it's watching you
rules: COVERT -- If this card inflicts damage to a faction, your opponent must discard 2 cards.
notes: Printed 'your opponent must discard 2 cards'; catalog 'that faction's controller discards 2 cards' (same in a 2-player game; newer multiplayer templating). No artist credit printed in footer.

name: Lugubrious Finger Trap
subtitle: a tragic opera of moral instruction in five parts
rules: ATTACH TO CHARACTER -- The attached character cannot attack or block.
flavor:
"O! Cruel Fate! By what loathsome witching have I befallen thus?"
— The Finger Trap, Act II
notes: No artist credit printed in footer.

name: Master Ritualist
subtitle: scheduler of obsession
rules: QUOTIDIAN INSTRUCTION -- COST – Deplete this card. -- EFFECT – Search your deck for a tactic, reveal it, and put it into your hand.
flavor: "I thought he was supposed to bring the marmalade!"
notes: Sentence structure differs slightly ('search ..., reveal it, and put it' vs 'search and reveal it. Put it'); same effect. 'he' is underlined in the flavor. No artist credit printed in footer.

name: Mephitic Nullifier
subtitle: sinister and cowardly
rules: FLASH-BANG -- COST – Destroy this card. Pick a character you control. -- EFFECT – Put the character into its owner's hand.
notes: No artist credit printed in footer.

name: Napiform Protuberance
subtitle: does it look serious?
rules: ATTACH TO CHARACTER -- This card enters play with 1 token on it. -- At the start of your turn, you may put a token on this card. -- The attached character loses 1 strength, 1 life, and 1 speed for each token on this card.
notes: No artist credit printed in footer.

name: Nearby Serpent
subtitle: well, at least i'm safe...
rules: COVERT -- When this card enters play, look at the top 5 cards of either deck and put them back in any order.
notes: Card prints 'look at the top 5 cards of either deck'; catalog has 'up to the top 5 cards of any one deck' (adds 'up to', changes deck wording). No artist credit printed in footer.

name: Obsession
printing: Landscape card; edition stamp reads '1st Edition PART 2'; footer rarity slot says STAPLE
notes: Staple resource card printed rotated; no rules text, no art credit, no collector number. Copyright 2007 and edition stamp says 1st Edition Part 2 although catalogued in 1st Edition.

name: Ominous Oozling
subtitle: squishing is the last thing you'll hear
rules: COVERT
flavor: Ms. Clotidia Dowdy, the first female explorer to successfully mount an expedition to the ephemeral North Ridge of Mt. Mulrich, seen here outside Blortingshire Manor a mere four hours before her tragic demise.
notes: No artist credit printed in footer.

name: Quotidian Assassination
subtitle: a convenient and cowardly solution
rules: COST – Pick a character. -- EFFECT – Put the character into its owner's hand.
flavor: When the shattering glass shatters, shatters, the cords are drawn slow, again again again, draw the cords, shatter the glass, draw the cords, shatter the glass, wait, silence, with care. Again...
notes: No artist credit printed in footer.

name: Quotidian Ejector
subtitle: trivially rejecting whatever he chooses
rules: This card enters play with 2 tokens on it. -- EJECT -- COST – Remove 2 tokens from this card. Pick a non-resource card. -- EFFECT – Put the card into its owner's hand.
notes: No artist credit printed in footer.

name: Quotidian Misfire
subtitle: hey, it happens
rules: This turn, if a card would be put into a player's hand from anywhere, instead put it into that player's discard pile. (This includes cards from your deck and cards you draw.)
flavor: If only I'd remembered to turn the knob 17 times instead of 16 and a half!
notes: Catalog omits 'from anywhere' and the italic reminder text, reorders 'put it into their discard pile instead'; same effect. No artist credit printed in footer.

name: Remember
subtitle: my memory is infallable...when it works
rules: COST – Pick a tactic in your discard pile. -- EFFECT – Put the tactic into your hand.
notes: Subtitle prints 'infallable' (misspelled on the card). No artist credit printed in footer.

name: Ritual of the Screaming Cheese
subtitle: the second strangest sound we've ever heard
rules: Your opponent must pick one of the following: -- OPTION 1 – They discard 2 cards. -- OPTION 2 – They discard a card at random.
flavor: "Is the cheese screaming, Clarice?"
notes: Catalog adds EXTRA COST: Pick an opponent (newer multiplayer templating); printed 'Your opponent must pick'. No artist credit printed in footer.

name: Ritual of the Shattering Teeth
subtitle: a painful but effective measure
rules: COST – Pick a number for X. Pay twice X. -- EFFECT – Look at your opponent's hand and pick X or fewer cards. Your opponent must discard those cards.
flavor: "I want you to know, this hurts you more than it hurts me."
notes: Printed 'Pay twice X', 'your opponent', 'pick'; catalog 'Pay X+X', 'an opponent', 'choose'. No artist credit printed in footer.

name: Servile Centipede
subtitle: your slithering servant
rules: When this card enters play, you may search your deck for a tactic. If you do, reveal it and put it into your hand.
notes: 'and reveal it' moved within the sentence in the catalog; same effect. No artist credit printed in footer.

name: Skimping Ecto-Manipulator
subtitle: he's paid less, and it shows
rules: ENERGIZE -- COST – Deplete this card. Pick a non-resource card you control. -- EFFECT – Put a token on the card.
notes: No artist credit printed in footer.

name: Sneaking Spitspider
subtitle: lurking in the shadows
rules: COVERT
flavor: "Actually honey...why don't you take care of this one."
notes: Type line prints the placeholder 'subtypes' instead of a real subtype (catalog has lurker). 'you' underlined in flavor. No artist credit printed in footer.

name: Sneaky Mansion
subtitle: limited edition artwork by Kenfoo
rules: COVERT
flavor: Kenfoo was bitten by a mansion when he was little. He hasn't eaten ice cream since.
notes: Artist credit only in subtitle (Kenfoo), not in footer.

name: Spastic Tentacles
subtitle: embarrassing domestic mishap
rules: When this card enters play, both players must put a resource they control into its owner's hand.
flavor: "For the last time, Myrtle! Lock the bedroom door when we have company over!"
notes: Printed 'both players must put'; catalog 'each player puts'. No artist credit printed in footer.

name: Spontaneous Displacement
subtitle: it's going to get worse before it gets better
rules: COST – Pick a non-resource card. X is half that card's numeric cost, rounded up. -- EFFECT – Put the card into its owner's hand. You may play a non-resource card with numeric cost X or less for free. (You still need the proper resource icons and must pay any additional costs.)
flavor: Or maybe it's just going to get worse.
notes: Catalog 'deploy' vs printed 'play'; reminder text worded differently. No artist credit printed in footer.

name: Stolen Inspiration
subtitle: i was just thinking that
rules: Look at your opponent's hand and pick a non-resource card. Your opponent must discard that card. -- You may play a non-resource card with numeric cost X or less for free, where X is half the numeric cost of the discarded card, rounded up. (You still need the proper resource icons and must pay any additional costs.)
notes: Catalog 'an opponent's hand / choose / That player discards / deploy' vs printed 'your opponent / pick / must discard / play'. No artist credit printed in footer.

name: Swarm of Gnats
subtitle: in Darkest Lugubria, gnat swats you!
rules: When this card enters or leaves play, your opponent must discard a card.
flavor:
"Yes, gnats! Vicious, nasty gnats with big, pointy stingers! To stick in your skin! And sting you! And they'll swarm all over you and fly in your face and plug up your nose and bite you in the...what do you mean 'gnats don't have stingers'...?"
— Millicent Holcroft to General J.G. Blargington III.
notes: Printed 'your opponent must discard'; catalog 'an opponent discards'. No artist credit printed in footer.

name: Very Big Hat of Invisibility
subtitle: as fashionable as it is unseeable
rules: ATTACH TO CHARACTER -- The attached character gains COVERT. -- HANDOFF -- COST – Deplete a character you control that is not in a battle. -- EFFECT – Attach this card to the character.
notes: No artist credit printed in footer.

name: Voidal Nullification Chamber
subtitle: key component of ecto-distillation
rules: At the start of your turn, you may put a token on this card. -- ENERGIZE -- COST – Pay 2. -- EFFECT – Put a token on this card. -- DISSOLVE -- COST – Use this only if an even number of characters are in play. Remove 4 tokens from this card. Pick a character. -- EFFECT – Destroy the character.
notes: No artist credit printed in footer.

name: Voidal Observatory
subtitle: precisely detects irrelevant details
rules: At the start of your turn, you may put a token on this card. -- ENERGIZE -- COST – Pay 2. -- EFFECT – Put a token on this card. -- STUDY -- COST – Remove 3 tokens from this card. -- EFFECT – Draw a card.
notes: No artist credit printed in footer.

name: Voidal Perversion
subtitle: keep that up and you're bound to go blind
rules: COST – Pick 2 or fewer non-resource cards. -- EFFECT – Put up to 2 tokens divided however you want on the cards. Draw a card.
notes: No artist credit printed in footer.

name: Voidal Poisoning
subtitle: magical hazard
rules: You may remove any number of tokens from cards you control. Use the tokens any way you want to create the following effects any number of times: -- 1 TOKEN – Pick a character. Inflict 1 damage to that character. -- 2 TOKENS – Draw a card. -- 2 TOKENS – Your opponent must discard a card. -- 3 TOKENS – Search your deck for a card and put it into your hand.
notes: Catalog 'Use the tokens to generate...', 'An opponent discards'; printed 'Use the tokens any way you want to create...', 'Your opponent must discard'. No artist credit printed in footer.

name: Voidal Replication
subtitle: corrupting magical experience
rules: Your opponent cannot respond to this card. -- COST – Play this only if a tactic has been played this turn. -- Duplicate the last tactic played this turn. (A duplicate retains all rules text including extra costs, which must be paid or the duplicate is invalid and has no effect.)
notes: Catalog folds 'cannot respond' into EXTRA COST and says 'deployed'; card prints it as a separate rules line and only the 'Play this only if...' line as COST. Catalog omits the italic reminder text. No artist credit printed in footer.

name: Voidal Webbing
subtitle: vexing residue of quotidian ritual
rules: COST – Pick a character. -- EFFECT – This turn, the character loses 1 speed.
flavor: "Missing? What do you mean I went missing? I was right here the whole time!"
notes: No artist credit printed in footer.

name: Zenobia's Spyglass
subtitle: for gazing upon the mysteries of the void
rules: FORESIGHT -- COST – Pick a number for X. Pay X. -- EFFECT – Look at the top X+X cards of your deck and put them back in any order.
flavor: And for gazing upon Millicent Holcroft's juicy caboose when Zenobia's not home.
notes: Card prints 'Look at the top X+X cards of your deck'; catalog has 'up to the top X+X cards' (adds 'up to'). No artist credit printed in footer.
